mapper.select:
-- Select matching cases for paginated operation screens. SELECT mc.id AS matching_case_id, mc.public_code AS matching_case_code, mc.announcement_id, a.public_code AS announcement_code, mc.member_user_id, u.public_code AS member_user_code, mc.verification_id, pv.public_code AS verification_code, mc.status_code, mc.blocked_reason_code, mc.matched_at, mc.reviewed_by, mc.reviewed_at, mc.created_at, mc.updated_at, a.title AS announcement_title, a.agency_name, a.target_type_code, a.min_amount, a.max_amount, a.application_start_date, a.application_end_date, u.login_id AS member_login_id, u.name AS member_name, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM application_progresses ap WHERE ap.matching_case_id = mc.id ) AS progress_created FROM matching_cases mc INNER JOIN announcements a ON a.id = mc.announcement_id INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = mc.member_user_id LEFT JOIN partner_verifications pv ON pv.id = mc.verification_id
ORDER BY a.application_end_date ASC NULLS LAST, a.application_start_date ASC NULLS LAST, mc.created_at ASC, mc.id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count matching cases for paginated list. SELECT count(1) FROM matching_cases mc

-- Select active member users for matching operation lookup modal. SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.public_code AS user_code, u.login_id, u.name, u.status_code, u.created_at FROM users u
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.login_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

-- Count active member users before condition-based candidate generation. SELECT count(1) FROM users u WHERE u.id = #{memberUserId} AND u.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_code = 'USER' )

-- Select approved announcements whose configured conditions match stored basic member data. SELECT a.id AS announcement_id, ( SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_numeric_conditions anc WHERE anc.announcement_id = a.id ) + ( SELECT count(1) FROM ( SELECT aoc.condition_scope_code, aoc.condition_key FROM announcement_option_conditions aoc WHERE aoc.announcement_id = a.id GROUP BY aoc.condition_scope_code, aoc.condition_key ) option_groups ) + ( SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_industry_conditions aic WHERE aic.announcement_id = a.id ) AS checked_condition_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_numeric_conditions anc WHERE anc.announcement_id = a.id ) + ( SELECT count(1) FROM ( SELECT aoc.condition_scope_code, aoc.condition_key FROM announcement_option_conditions aoc WHERE aoc.announcement_id = a.id GROUP BY aoc.condition_scope_code, aoc.condition_key ) option_groups ) + ( SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_industry_conditions aic WHERE aic.announcement_id = a.id ) AS matched_condition_count FROM announcements a LEFT JOIN member_profiles mp ON mp.user_id = #{memberUserId} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT bp.opening_date, bp.ksic_code, bp.workplace_region_code, bp.business_type_code, bp.company_stage_code, bp.annual_revenue, bp.has_policy_fund_usage, bp.has_guarantee_usage FROM business_profiles bp WHERE bp.user_id = #{memberUserId} ORDER BY bp.created_at DESC, bp.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) bp ON true WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND a.manual_status_code = 'NORMAL' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM matching_cases mc WHERE mc.announcement_id = a.id AND mc.member_user_id = #{memberUserId} AND mc.verification_id IS NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_industry_conditions aic WHERE aic.announcement_id = a.id AND ( ( aic.condition_type_code = 'INCLUDE' AND (bp.ksic_code IS NULL OR bp.ksic_code <> aic.ksic_code) ) OR ( aic.condition_type_code = 'EXCLUDE' AND bp.ksic_code = aic.ksic_code ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_numeric_conditions anc CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN anc.condition_scope_code = 'BUSINESS' AND anc.condition_key IN ('ANNUAL_REVENUE', 'SUPPLY_AMOUNT', 'TOTAL_INCOME_AMOUNT') THEN bp.annual_revenue WHEN anc.condition_scope_code = 'BUSINESS' AND anc.condition_key IN ('BUSINESS_YEARS', 'BUSINESS_AGE', 'BUSINESS_AGE_YEARS') AND bp.opening_date IS NOT NULL THEN floor(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(current_date, bp.opening_date)))::numeric WHEN anc.condition_scope_code = 'PERSONAL' AND anc.condition_key = 'AGE' AND mp.birth_year IS NOT NULL THEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM current_date)::integer - mp.birth_year)::numeric WHEN anc.condition_scope_code = 'PERSONAL' AND anc.condition_key IN ('INCOME_AMOUNT', 'TOTAL_INCOME_AMOUNT') THEN mp.income_amount WHEN anc.condition_scope_code = 'CHILD' AND anc.condition_key IN ('CHILD_COUNT', 'FAMILY_CHILD_COUNT') THEN ( SELECT count(1)::numeric FROM family_members fm WHERE fm.user_id = #{memberUserId} AND fm.relation_type_code = 'CHILD' ) WHEN anc.condition_scope_code = 'PARENT' AND anc.condition_key IN ('PARENT_COUNT', 'FAMILY_PARENT_COUNT') THEN ( SELECT count(1)::numeric FROM family_members fm WHERE fm.user_id = #{memberUserId} AND fm.relation_type_code = 'PARENT' ) WHEN anc.condition_scope_code = 'SPOUSE' AND anc.condition_key IN ('SPOUSE_COUNT', 'HAS_SPOUSE') THEN ( SELECT count(1)::numeric FROM family_members fm WHERE fm.user_id = #{memberUserId} AND fm.relation_type_code = 'SPOUSE' ) WHEN anc.condition_scope_code = 'APPLICATION' AND anc.condition_key IN ('HOUSEHOLD_MEMBER_COUNT', 'FAMILY_MEMBER_COUNT') THEN ( SELECT count(1)::numeric FROM family_members fm WHERE fm.user_id = #{memberUserId} ) ELSE NULL::numeric END AS basis_number ) basis WHERE anc.announcement_id = a.id AND ( basis.basis_number IS NULL OR NOT ( (anc.comparator_code = 'BETWEEN' AND basis.basis_number BETWEEN anc.min_number AND anc.max_number) OR (anc.comparator_code = 'GTE' AND basis.basis_number >= anc.value_number) OR (anc.comparator_code = 'LTE' AND basis.basis_number <= anc.value_number) OR (anc.comparator_code = 'GT' AND basis.basis_number > anc.value_number) OR (anc.comparator_code = 'LT' AND basis.basis_number < anc.value_number) OR (anc.comparator_code = 'EQ' AND basis.basis_number = anc.value_number) ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT aoc.condition_scope_code, aoc.condition_key, array_agg(aoc.option_code ORDER BY aoc.option_code) AS option_codes FROM announcement_option_conditions aoc WHERE aoc.announcement_id = a.id GROUP BY aoc.condition_scope_code, aoc.condition_key ) option_groups CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN option_groups.condition_scope_code = 'BUSINESS' AND option_groups.condition_key = 'WORKPLACE_REGION_CODE' THEN bp.workplace_region_code WHEN option_groups.condition_scope_code = 'BUSINESS' AND option_groups.condition_key = 'BUSINESS_TYPE_CODE' THEN bp.business_type_code WHEN option_groups.condition_scope_code = 'BUSINESS' AND option_groups.condition_key IN ('BUSINESS_STAGE', 'COMPANY_STAGE') THEN bp.company_stage_code WHEN option_groups.condition_scope_code = 'BUSINESS' AND option_groups.condition_key = 'HAS_POLICY_FUND_USAGE' THEN CASE WHEN bp.has_policy_fund_usage IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN bp.has_policy_fund_usage THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END WHEN option_groups.condition_scope_code = 'BUSINESS' AND option_groups.condition_key = 'HAS_GUARANTEE_USAGE' THEN CASE WHEN bp.has_guarantee_usage IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN bp.has_guarantee_usage THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END WHEN option_groups.condition_scope_code = 'PERSONAL' AND option_groups.condition_key = 'REGION_CODE' THEN mp.region_code WHEN option_groups.condition_scope_code = 'PERSONAL' AND option_groups.condition_key = 'HEALTH_INSURANCE_BASIS_CODE' THEN mp.health_insurance_basis_code WHEN option_groups.condition_scope_code = 'PERSONAL' AND option_groups.condition_key = 'HAS_INCOME' THEN CASE WHEN mp.has_income IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN mp.has_income THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END WHEN option_groups.condition_scope_code = 'CHILD' AND option_groups.condition_key IN ('HAS_CHILD', 'CHILD_COUNT') THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM family_members fm WHERE fm.user_id = #{memberUserId} AND fm.relation_type_code = 'CHILD' ) THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END WHEN option_groups.condition_scope_code = 'SPOUSE' AND option_groups.condition_key IN ('HAS_SPOUSE', 'SPOUSE_COUNT') THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM family_members fm WHERE fm.user_id = #{memberUserId} AND fm.relation_type_code = 'SPOUSE' ) THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END WHEN option_groups.condition_scope_code = 'PARENT' AND option_groups.condition_key IN ('HAS_PARENT', 'PARENT_COUNT') THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM family_members fm WHERE fm.user_id = #{memberUserId} AND fm.relation_type_code = 'PARENT' ) THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END ELSE NULL END AS basis_option_code ) basis WHERE basis.basis_option_code IS NULL OR NOT (basis.basis_option_code = ANY(option_groups.option_codes)) ) ORDER BY a.application_end_date ASC NULLS LAST, a.application_start_date ASC NULLS LAST, a.created_at ASC, a.id ASC
-- Count active member users for matching operation lookup modal. SELECT count(1) FROM users u

-- Select matching case details by primary key. SELECT mc.id AS matching_case_id, mc.public_code AS matching_case_code, mc.announcement_id, a.public_code AS announcement_code, mc.member_user_id, u.public_code AS member_user_code, mc.verification_id, pv.public_code AS verification_code, mc.status_code, mc.blocked_reason_code, mc.matched_at, mc.reviewed_by, mc.reviewed_at, mc.created_at, mc.updated_at, a.title AS announcement_title, a.agency_name, a.target_type_code, a.min_amount, a.max_amount, a.application_start_date, a.application_end_date, u.login_id AS member_login_id, u.name AS member_name, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM application_progresses ap WHERE ap.matching_case_id = mc.id ) AS progress_created FROM matching_cases mc INNER JOIN announcements a ON a.id = mc.announcement_id INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = mc.member_user_id LEFT JOIN partner_verifications pv ON pv.id = mc.verification_id WHERE mc.id = #{matchingCaseId}

-- Select condition-level matching result details. SELECT mrd.id AS matching_result_detail_id, mrd.matching_case_id, mrd.condition_scope_code, mrd.condition_key, mrd.result_code, mrd.basis_value, mrd.required_value, mrd.reason, mrd.created_at FROM matching_result_details mrd WHERE mrd.matching_case_id = #{matchingCaseId} ORDER BY mrd.condition_scope_code ASC, mrd.condition_key ASC
-- Select announcement status fields needed before matching creation. SELECT a.id AS announcement_id, a.manual_status_code, a.approval_status_code FROM announcements a WHERE a.id = #{announcementId}

-- Select verification status fields needed before matching creation. SELECT pv.id AS verification_id, pv.member_user_id, pv.status_code, pv.is_current, pv.is_matching_blocked FROM partner_verifications pv WHERE pv.id = #{verificationId}

-- Select checked restriction flags used for MVP status classification. SELECT vrf.restriction_code FROM verification_restriction_flags vrf WHERE vrf.verification_id = #{verificationId} AND vrf.is_checked = true ORDER BY vrf.restriction_code ASC
mapper.insert: -- Insert matching case with only status and restriction reason fields. INSERT INTO matching_cases ( id, announcement_id, member_user_id, verification_id, status_code, blocked_reason_code, matched_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{matchingCaseId}, #{announcementId}, #{memberUserId}, #{verificationId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{statusCode}, #{blockedReasonCode}, now(), #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )

-- Insert MVP matching result detail with only PASS, FAIL, SKIPPED, or REVIEW_REQUIRED. INSERT INTO matching_result_details ( id, matching_case_id, condition_scope_code, condition_key, result_code, basis_value, required_value, reason, created_by ) VALUES ( #{matchingResultDetailId}, #{matchingCaseId}, #{conditionScopeCode}, #{conditionKey}, #{resultCode}, #{basisValue}, #{requiredValue}, #{reason}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update matching case status manually without creating application progress. UPDATE matching_cases SET status_code = #{statusCode}, blocked_reason_code = #{blockedReasonCode}, reviewed_by = #{actorUserId}, reviewed_at = now(), updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{matchingCaseId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert non-PII matching operation audit log. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
